messages:
Ashley: Acme POC - getting 429s during a short parallel upload run at ~45s in. logs (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

Samir: paste the sample error + headers? need to know if it's per-route rpm or token-rate.

acme-agent: "{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}"
Response headers: x-ratelimit-limit:60, x-ratelimit-remaining:0, x-ratelimit-reset:12

Miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate short window = 60 rpm. Are they running multiple parallel workers?

Ashley: yes - 8 workers each ~1 req/s, avg payload ~1200 tokens.

Jia: quick calc: ~480 requests in the minute -> hits per-route cap first. Token-rate also matters but per-route is the immediate throttle.

rate-limiter-bot: Quota snapshot for org "acme-corp": monthly_token_budget=5,000,000; tokens_used_mtd=1,100,432; per_minute_token_rate_limit=20000; per_route_requests_per_minute(/v1/generate)=60.

Miguel: Sales asked for a temporary bump for the POC. Proposed: rpm=140, token_rate=30000.

Samir: applying now:
redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 140 --token-rate 30000 --note "trial bump for Acme POC"
(Change q-98440)

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (q-98440). New per-route rpm=140, token_rate=30000 tokens/min.

Ashley: customer re-ran; short log still showed one 429 immediately after the change: 
[2026-05-12T09:21:17Z] POST /v1/generate 200 1180 tokens
[2026-05-12T09:21:18Z] POST /v1/generate 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0

Miguel: likely window-edge propagation. Recommend adding burst_capacity to absorb startup parallelism.

Jia: suggest burst_capacity=300 over 30s and advise client-side jittered backoff.

Samir: patching burst policy:
redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 300 --burst_window 30
(Change q-98441)

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org "acme-corp" (q-98441). burst_capacity=300, burst_window=30s.

acme-agent: reran: "errors dropped to near zero 389 huge improvement"

Miguel: SRE note: for POCs with parallel clients start rpm=120-200, token-rate=25k-50k tokens/min, burst_capacity=200-400/30s. Recommend client jittered exponential backoff to avoid thundering-herd.

Jia: filed INF-4532 to add a sales-facing quota-bump template and auto-expiry audit.

Samir: changes recorded (q-98440, q-98441). Auto-expire in 7 days unless extended.

Ashley: will follow up if Acme needs extension. Marking resolved from sales side; monitoring for 2 hours. Thanks everyone <3
